_readme: Walking NPC dialogue. Each NPC has 'conversations' (multi-line scenes, each shown once, highest priority first when its 'when' conditions match) and then 'smallTalk' one-liners drawn from a shuffle bag, prefixed by a 'returnGreetings' line. Speakers: 'npc' or 'you'. Placeholders: {player}, {vod} (vendor of the day), {vodShop}, {saved}, {bought}. Conditions in 'when': minVisits, maxVisits, boughtFrom, notBoughtFrom, boughtAny, boughtNone, minBought, kickedOutBy, vendorOfDay, timeOfDay (morning|afternoon|evening|night).

aaji.name: Shanta Aaji
aaji.role: Has shopped in this market for fifty years

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Arre deva! Naya chehra. Kaun re tu, baala?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Main {player}. Pehli baar is bazaar mein aaya hoon.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Pehli baar? Toh sun. Is bazaar mein koi bhi pehla daam sach nahi bolta.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Pachaas saal se yahan sabzi le rahi hoon. Mujhe koi nahi loot sakta. Tujhe sab loot lenge, agar dhyaan nahi diya.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Jaa, ghoom le. Kuch poochna ho toh Aaji yahin hai.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Pinky ke paas gaya? Woh ladki meethi baatein karti hai, par dil ki achhi hai.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Uska rate bahut zyada hai, Aaji.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Haan re. Ek raaz batati hoon. Usse bol har mahine aayega. Pakke grahak ke liye woh pighal jaati hai.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Aur uske chawal ki taarif karna. Jhooth nahi, sach mein achhe hain.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Ramesh ko dekha? Woh aur main ek hi saal is bazaar mein aaye the.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Tab uske baal kaale the aur tamatar do rupaye kilo.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Woh bahut ziddi hai.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Ziddi nahi, izzatdaar hai. Usse 'Kaka' bol, pyaar se baat kar. Chillaayega toh woh bhi chillaayega.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Pinky se chawal le liya? Shabaash!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Pakate waqt paani dedh guna daalna, zyada nahi. Aur pehle aadha ghanta bhigo dena.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Aap toh poori recipe de rahi ho, Aaji.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Recipe free hai. Sirf mol-bhaav ke paise lagte hain.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Ramesh ne tujhe bhaga diya? Hahaha!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Maine kaha tha na, pyaar se. Thodi der ruk, uska gussa chai jaisa hai. Jaldi ubalta hai, jaldi thanda hota hai.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Subah subah bazaar aaya? Achha kiya. Is waqt maal sabse taaza hota hai.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Par dukandaar bhi taaze hote hain, aur ziddi bhi. Shaam ko sab thak jaate hain.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Shaam ho gayi. Ab dukaan band hone ka waqt hai.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Is waqt dukandaar ko maal khatam karna hota hai. Achha mauka hai daam girane ka.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Ek baat yaad rakh baala. Bahut kam daam bolega toh dukandaar ka mood bigdega.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Aadha daam se shuru kar, bas. Usse neeche gaya toh woh tujhe gambhirta se nahi lega.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Teeno dukaan se kharida? Arre wah!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: ₹{saved} bachaye? Mere pote ko bhi itni akal nahi hai. Tu toh asli Mumbaikar ban gaya.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Mera pota Pune mein software engineer hai. Online sab mangwata hai.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Online toh aasaan hai, Aaji.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Aasaan hai, par wahan koi 'baala' bolke ek dhaniya free nahi deta.

returnGreetings: Tu toh roz ka ho gaya ab.
smallTalk: Mere ghutne dukhte hain, par bazaar aana nahi chhodti.
Aajkal ke bachche bhindi aur tinda mein farak nahi jaante.
Pehle yahan ek bada peepal ka ped tha. Ab sirf dukaan hi dukaan.
Dhaniya kabhi khareedna mat, maang lena. Har dukandaar deta hai.
Tamatar laal aur thode sakht lena. Naram wale ghar tak pahunchte pahunchte sad jaate hain.
Mere zamaane mein ek rupaye mein poora thaila bhar jaata tha.
Aaj ka special {vod} hai. Wahan zara dhyaan se jaana.
Kabhi jaldi mein mol-bhaav mat kar. Jaldi wala hi haarta hai.
Main sirf dekhne aati hoon ab. Ghar pe koi baat karne wala nahi hai.
Pintu ki chai pee? Meethi bahut banata hai, par dil ka achha hai.
Bunty ko dekha kahin? Woh ladka poora din cricket khelta hai.
Kamat ko mat sun zyada. Woh har cheez ka hisaab lagata hai, maze ka nahi.
Baarish mein yahan ghutno tak paani bhar jaata hai. Tab sabse sasta maal milta hai.
Tu khaana banata hai ya sirf khareedta hai?
Muskura ke mol-bhaav kar. Gussa daam badhata hai.
Mera Ganpati ka prasad yahin ke gud se banta hai, har saal.
Mere pati bhi aise hi mol-bhaav karte the. Har baar haar jaate the.
Aaj dhoop tez hai. Paani pee le, baala.

kamat.name: Kamat Uncle
kamat.role: Retired bank clerk who treats bargaining like maths

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Excuse me. Aap naye ho? Main Kamat. Retired, Bank of Maharashtra, 34 saal.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Ab mera ek hi shauk hai: mol-bhaav ka data collect karna.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Data? Bazaar mein?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Haan ji. Har dukandaar ka ek pattern hota hai. Samajh gaye toh jeet gaye.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Rule number one. Pehla offer hamesha pehle daam ka 55 se 65 percent.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Usse kam bologe toh dukandaar ko lagega aap mazaak kar rahe ho. Patience seedha girta hai.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Aur zyada bolun toh?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Toh aapne paise pehle hi de diye. Bargaining shuru hone se pehle khatam.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Sirf number mat bolo. Number ke saath kaaran do.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: 'Roz aaunga', 'dusri dukaan mein sasta hai', 'do bori lunga', 'student hoon'. Har kaaran pe daam 3 se 7 percent girta hai.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Maine notebook mein likha hai. 212 observations.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Walk away trick jaante ho?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Chale jaane ka natak?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Bilkul. Teen mein se do baar dukandaar wapas bulata hai, 6 se 10 percent kam pe.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Par sirf ek baar chalta hai. Aur agar uska sabr pehle hi kam ho, toh woh bulayega nahi. Jaane dega.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Patience meter dekhte ho? Woh sabse important number hai.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Gaali di, same number repeat kiya, faaltu baat ki: sab se girta hai. Taarif ki, toh thoda badhta hai.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Zero hua toh aap bahar. Aur 30 second tak woh dukandaar aapse baat nahi karega.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Aapne kuch khareeda. Score kaise banta hai, pata hai?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Har dukandaar ka ek secret minimum hota hai. Aap us minimum ke kitne paas pahunche, uske 100 points.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Aur kam baaton mein deal ki toh 30 tak bonus. Jaldi aur sasta, dono chahiye.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Leaderboard pe players ka total kaise banta hai? Har dukaan ka aapka best score, jod ke.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Matlab ek hi dukaan se baar baar khareedne se kuch nahi hoga. Teeno dukaan pe achha karna padega.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Aapka score kitna hai, Uncle?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Main khelta nahi. Main sirf analyse karta hoon. Wahi toh asli maza hai.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Salim ka data interesting hai. Uska sabr sabse kam hai. Sirf chhe-saat baatein.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Wahan seedha, confident bolo. Machhi ki aankh, gills ki baat karo. Woh jaankaar grahak ki izzat karta hai.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Aaj ka special {vod} hai, {vodShop}. Wahan chamakti roshni dekhi?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Special ka matlab sasta nahi. Special ka matlab sab wahan jaate hain. Competition zyada.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Salim ne nikaal diya? Main samajh gaya. Aapne time zyada liya.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Observation number 213. Note kar liya.

returnGreetings: Phir se? Good. Consistency achhi cheez hai.
Aapka data bhi likh raha hoon, bura mat maaniye.
Oh, aap. Kaisa chal raha hai experiment?
smallTalk: Aaj tamatar ka average daam kal se 4 percent zyada hai. Baarish ka asar.
Mol-bhaav emotion nahi hai, maths hai. Par dukandaar ko yeh mat batana.
Bank mein 34 saal loan diye. Ab bazaar mein discount leta hoon. Circle poora.
Mere notebook mein har dukaan ka alag page hai.
Ek hi number do baar bolna sabse badi galti hai. Dukandaar chid jaata hai.
Aapne kabhi dekha, dukandaar gol number pe jaldi maanta hai? ₹500, ₹700. Psychology.
Retire hone ke baad sabse bada sawaal: poora din kya karun. Jawaab: yeh bazaar.
Online discount algorithm deta hai. Yahan insaan deta hai. Insaan ko samajhna mushkil hai.
Pintu ki chai ₹10 ki hai. Maine kabhi mol-bhaav nahi kiya. Kuch cheezon ka daam izzat hota hai.
Meri wife kehti hai main mol-bhaav mein zyada time lagata hoon. Data kehta hai woh sahi hai.
Kabhi bhi apna budget pehle mat batao.
Taarif karne se daam 0 se 3 percent girta hai. Kam hai, par free hai.
Main har Tuesday aata hoon. Tuesday ko bheed kam hoti hai.
Bunty ne mujhse ek baar mol-bhaav kiya, apni cricket ball ke liye. Main haar gaya.
Shaam ko dukandaar thake hote hain. Thaka dukandaar jaldi maanta hai.
Rukhsana Aapa se kabhi mol-bhaav mat karna. Woh machhi ki professor hai.

bunty.name: Bunty
bunty.role: Twelve-year-old errand runner and cricket fanatic

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Oye! Tum naye ho na? Main Bunty. Is bazaar ka asli malik.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Malik? Tum toh chhote ho.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Umar chhoti hai, network bada hai. Sabka saaman main hi pahunchata hoon.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Kuch chahiye toh bolna. Fees sirf ek Parle-G.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Salim Bhai ke paas gaye? Woh har baar bolta hai 'subah 5 baje ki boat'.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Main subah 5 baje wahan hota hoon. Aadhi machhi toh kal ki hoti hai. Hehe.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Sach mein?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Mat batana usko ki maine bola. Par tum 'boss' bol ke baat karo, woh khush ho jaata hai.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Tum cricket khelte ho?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Thoda thoda.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Main Mumbai ka next Sachin banunga. Ya kam se kam next Rohit.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Pichhle hafte maine Ramesh Kaka ki dukaan pe six maara tha. Gobhi ne catch kar liya. Out.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Tumne abhi tak kuch nahi khareeda? Darr lagta hai kya?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Challenge: Ramesh Kaka se 25 percent kam karwa ke dikhao. Maine ek baar 20 kiya tha.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Aur jeeta toh?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Toh main tumhe apna best trick bataunga. Promise.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Tumne Kaka se khareed liya! Theek hai, trick batata hoon.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Pehle maal ki taarif karo. Phir bolo 'roz aaunga'. Phir number bolo. Teeno ek ke baad ek.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Ulta kiya toh Kaka ki moonchh khadi ho jaati hai.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Hahaha! Pinky Didi ne tumhe bhaga diya? Woh toh kisi ko nahi bhagaati!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Tumne kya bola? Bahut ghatiya offer diya hoga.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Dopahar mein sab dukandaar oonghte hain. Dekho Kaka ki aankh band ho rahi hai.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Neend mein aadmi jaldi haan bol deta hai. Try karo.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Tum school nahi jaate?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Jaata hoon na! Subah. Abhi toh extra class chal rahi hai. Bazaar class.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Maths yahin seekhta hoon. Kamat Uncle se bhi tez hisaab hai mera.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Teeno dukaan? Tum toh legend ho!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Ab tum mere guru. Mujhe bhi sikhao. Main tumhe free mein Parle-G dunga.

returnGreetings: Tum toh roz dikhte ho ab!
smallTalk: Mujhe koi ₹10 de do, vada pav khana hai.
Kamat Uncle ki notebook maine ek baar padhi. Sab numbers. Bore.
Pintu ki chai pee? Main usse free mein leta hoon. Setting hai.
Aaji mujhe roz ek gajar deti hai. Main use nahi batata ki mujhe gajar pasand nahi.
Kal match hai. Main bhi khelunga. Ball kharido mere liye?
Pinky Didi mujhe 'hero' bolti hai. Main sach mein hero hoon.
Yahan ek billi hai, uska naam Tiger hai. Machhi churaati hai Salim Bhai se.
Tumne gaaye dekhi? Woh bhi roz aati hai. Sabse bada grahak.
Aaj ka special {vod} hai. Main wahan se door rehta hoon. Bheed.
Mera sapna hai ek din poora bazaar khareed lunga.
Rukhsana Aapa se darr lagta hai. Woh ek baar mein samajh jaati hai kaun jhooth bol raha hai.
Mujhe local train mein bina seat ke khade rehna aata hai. Superpower.
Maine suna tumne ₹{saved} bachaye. Mujhe bhi share do.
Dopahar ko yahan cricket khelte hain. Tum aaoge?
Kaka ki dukaan ka tamatar main kabhi nahi churaata. Kabhi kabhi.
Mera bhai Dubai mein hai. Woh bolta hai wahan mol-bhaav nahi hota. Boring jagah hai.

rukhsana.name: Rukhsana Aapa
rukhsana.role: Koli fisherwoman from the dock, knows every fish by its eyes

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Tu naya hai. Chaal se pata chalta hai.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Main Rukhsana. Mere abba, unke abba, sab isi samandar pe the.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Aap bhi machhi bechti ho?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Bechti thi. Ab sirf dekhti hoon kaun kisko kya bech raha hai. Aur hansti hoon.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Salim se machhi lene jaa raha hai? Pehle yeh seekh le.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Aankh saaf aur chamakdaar honi chahiye. Dhundhli aankh matlab purani.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Gills laal. Bhoori ho toh chhod de. Aur dabane pe maas wapas uthna chahiye.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Salim ko yeh sab bolega toh woh samjhega tu jaanta hai. Phir daam girega.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Salim mera bhateeja jaisa hai. Uska baap aur mere shohar ek hi boat pe the.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Toh aap uski side lengi?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Main machhi ki side leti hoon. Machhi jhooth nahi bolti. Log bolte hain.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Pomfret le li? Dikha zara.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Hmm, theek hai. Tawa fry kar, halka masala, kokum ke saath. Zyada masala daala toh machhi rooth jayegi.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Machhi rooth jayegi?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Haan. Swaad chala jayega. Wahi rootna hai.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Shaam ho gayi. Ab Salim ko machhi khatam karni hai, warna barf ka kharcha.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Is waqt mol-bhaav karega toh woh jaldi maanega. Samandar ka niyam hai.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Monsoon mein boat nahi jaati. Do mahine.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Us waqt jo machhi milti hai, woh ya toh sookhi hai ya jhooth. Yaad rakhna.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Salim ne bhaga diya tujhe? Main dekh rahi thi.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Tu bahut der tak ek hi baat bol raha tha. Machhi wala jaldi mein rehta hai. Seedha bol, jaldi bol.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Tujhe pata hai, yeh shehar humara tha pehle? Koli log. Mumba Devi humari devi hai.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Ab building bahut hain, samandar kam dikhta hai. Par samandar kahin nahi gaya. Woh intezaar kar raha hai.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Aaj Salim special hai. Sab wahan ja rahe hain.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Bheed mein woh daam kam nahi karta. Thoda ruk, bheed hatne de.

returnGreetings: Samandar ki hawa achhi lagi tujhe?
Tu toh roz ka ho gaya.
smallTalk: Bombil ko Bombay duck kehte hain. Na woh duck hai, na ab shehar Bombay.
Surmai sabse mehngi hoti hai. Par swaad pomfret ka hi hai.
Samandar ka mood aur dukandaar ka mood, dono ek jaise badalte hain.
Machhi ko kabhi barf mein zyada der mat rakhna. Swaad marta hai.
Mere haath dekh. Pachaas saal ka namak hai inme.
Is dock pe subah char baje sabse zyada shor hota hai. Ab dekh, kitna shaant.
Tiger billi ko dekha? Woh sabse chaalaak grahak hai. Kabhi paise nahi deti.
Kokum aur machhi, jaise chai aur baarish.
Jo zyada kasam khaata hai, woh zyada jhooth bolta hai. Bazaar ka niyam.
Boat pe bhi mol-bhaav hota hai. Wahan asli khel hai.
Aaj lehrein oonchi hain. Kal machhi kam aayegi. Daam badhenge.
Kamat mujhse poochta hai machhi ka daam kyun badalta hai. Main kehti hoon, samandar se pooch.
Tune ₹{saved} bachaye? Ek machhi aur le leta.
Mera beta boat nahi chalata. Uber chalata hai. Waqt badal gaya.
Pinky ki masala mix achhi hai machhi ke liye. Usse pooch lena.

pintu.name: Pintu Chaiwala
pintu.role: Walks the market with a kettle, knows every rumour

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Chaaaai! Garam chai! Oh, naya grahak!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Pintu naam hai. Chai ₹10, gossip free.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Gossip kaisa?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Kaun kisse naraz hai, kaun aaj sasta de raha hai, kaun ki biwi ne daanta. Sab Pintu jaanta hai.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Breaking news! Aaj ka special {vod}, {vodShop} pe.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Wahan peela chamakta hai, dekha? Log wahi jaate hain. Tu bhi jaa, par dimaag lagake.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Ramesh Kaka ka mood aaj theek hai. Subah maine unko adrak wali chai di.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Adrak wali chai ke baad woh 5 percent zyada dayalu ho jaate hain. Scientific fact.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Kamat Uncle ne yeh likha hai?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Kamat Uncle ne mujhse hi seekha hai!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Ek baat bataun? Pinky Didi aur Salim Bhai mein jhagda hai.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Kyun?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Salim ne bola uski machhi ke saath Pinky ka masala free milna chahiye. Pinky ne bola 'free mein toh sirf muskaan milti hai'.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Tab se dono ek doosre ko dekh ke 'hmph' karte hain.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Suna tune {bought} khareeda! Poore bazaar mein khabar hai.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Deal ke baad chai toh banti hai. Aaj pehli meri taraf se.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Pinky Didi naraz? Arre baap re. Yeh khabar toh chai se bhi garam hai!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Aadha minute ruk. Phir jaa ke taarif kar, uska gussa pighal jaayega.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Itni raat ko bazaar? Tu bhi mere jaisa hai, neend nahi aati.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Raat ko sab dukandaar ghar jaane ki jaldi mein hote hain. Sasta milega, try kar.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Tu kaunsi local leta hai? Western, Central, Harbour?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Jo pehle aaye.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Sahi jawaab. Asli Mumbaikar.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Mera sapna hai apna chai cafe kholna. Naam hoga 'Pintu's Chai Lounge'.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Wahan bhi ₹10 ki chai. Bas kursi hogi. Aur WiFi.

returnGreetings: Phir se? Chai ki talab lagi?
smallTalk: Chai mein adrak zyada, cheeni kam. Yeh Mumbai ka niyam hai. Main todta hoon.
Aaj Bunty ne teen cutting pee. Paise? Kal dega. Hamesha kal.
Aaji kehti hai meri chai meethi hai. Phir bhi do pee jaati hai.
Kamat Uncle ne meri chai ka 'cost analysis' kiya. Bola main loss mein hoon. Sahi bola.
Baarish mein chai ka business double. Bhagwan baarish de.
Rukhsana Aapa ko chai nahi, kaali coffee chahiye. Main unke liye alag banata hoon.
Kal ek angrez aaya tha. 'Masala tea' bola. Maine ₹50 liya. Mazaak tha, ₹10 wapas kiye.
Salim Bhai chai ke saath bhi mol-bhaav karta hai. ₹10 ki chai ₹8 mein. Har din.
Tu ₹{saved} bachake ghoom raha hai aur ₹10 ki chai nahi le raha?
Mera kettle 12 saal purana hai. Isse zyada vafadaar koi nahi.
